name: Independent Northeast / Mid-Atlantic undergraduate CS coverage benchmark
notes: Independent public-web benchmark. The 106-row CT/NY/MD/DC legacy panel is preserved unchanged, then six rows per newly covered state were selected without consulting the Yartchives feed. Authoritative employer/ATS URLs replace discovery links only after selection; discovery provenance remains separate. first_discovered_at is omitted because continuous first-seen monitoring was not available.

sampling_method.design: Frozen independent legacy panel plus equal-quota geographic expansion
sampling_method.selection_order: Search-result order by query family in the listed order, round-robin across families
sampling_method.eligibility: Publicly discoverable, current 2026-2027 recruiting-cycle internship/co-op located in scope and relevant to an undergraduate CS or adjacent technical major
exclusions: closed or unverifiable listings at collection time
sampling_method.authoritative_url_policy: Preserve the discovery surface and query separately; replace the listing URL with an employer/ATS URL when discoverable without altering inclusion.
